title: Track A: Distribution — .construct/ layout + bootstrap shims + portable hooks
description: Project-local install layout. Peers who clone a project that uses Construct can run it end-to-end without a global install regardless of language ecosystem. Ships .construct/{version,bootstrap.sh,bootstrap.ps1,run.mjs}; hook commands in settings.json switch from 'npx --no construct hook X' to 'node .construct/run.mjs hook X'. Includes detect-runtime logic (npx → docker → binary → error).

title: Make Construct work for cloners without a global install
description: When developer A inits Construct in project X and developer B clones it, B currently gets only the docs (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cx/) — no agents, no hooks, no personas. Land project-pinned distribution: construct hook CLI dispatch, project-mode settings.json + agents committed in repo, npm postinstall runs setup --project, hook commands use npx so paths are local.

title: Retrieval evaluation harness with fixture queries
description: Without a fixed eval set the RRF+MMR pipeline's quality claims aren't measurable. Add lib/engine/eval-retrieval.mjs (Recall@k, MRR, NDCG@k), tests/fixtures/retrieval-eval/queries.json, a 'construct evals retrieval' CLI, and a regression test that fails if the metrics drop below a baseline.

title: construct hook <name> CLI dispatch
description: Add a hook subcommand to bin/construct that takes a hook name and runs the corresponding lib/hooks/*.mjs script, so settings.json can use 'npx construct hook X' instead of an absolute /Users/geralddagher path.

title: Phase B4: Postgres migration runner with version + hash tracking
description: lib/storage/sync.mjs:87 client.unsafe(schema) runs raw SQL on every sync, no version table. Create construct_schema_migrations(filename, sha, applied_at). Walk db/migrations/*.sql lexically, apply only unseen, hash-lock so changing applied files fails fast. construct doctor reports last applied + drift.
close_reason: Phase B4 complete. lib/storage/migrations.mjs::runMigrations + describeMigrations. Bookkeeping table construct_schema_migrations bootstrapped via db/migrations/004_schema_migrations_table.sql. Lexical ordering, idempotent re-runs, hash-locked drift detection (changing an applied file = hard error with diff). lib/storage/sync.mjs::ensureHybridSchema now delegates to runMigrations. construct doctor reports 'Schema migrations applied + no drift' when SQL configured. 4 unit tests via mock client (no Docker dependency). 814/814 full suite green.

title: Phase B3: Cross-surface parity verifier in construct doctor
description: construct sync writes Claude/OpenCode/Codex adapters but nothing diffs them post-write. Add doctor step: diff registry agents/personas/hooks vs ~/.claude/agents/, ~/.opencode/config.json, ~/.config/Codeium/. Exit non-zero on divergence with per-surface report. Surface flags (claudeOnly: true) opt out of mirroring.

title: Phase A4: Pre-push-gate parallelism (timeout fix)
description: lib/hooks/pre-push-gate.mjs runs test+build sequentially (90+120=210s) but harness timeout is 180s. Replace serial spawnSync with Promise.all of child_process.spawn so wall-clock = max(test, build) under budget.
close_reason: Phase A4 complete. lib/hooks/pre-push-gate.mjs now runs test+build via spawn() with Promise.all instead of serial spawnSync. Wall-clock = max(test, build) instead of sum. Each job has its own timer + SIGKILL on timeout. 180s harness budget now comfortably accommodates two 90-120s jobs. Smoke-tested: non-push echo still passes through. hooks-budget tests green.

title: Phase A3: OpenAI embedding adapter — graceful degradation policy
description: lib/storage/embeddings-openai.mjs throws on missing OPENAI_API_KEY. Engine should resolve OpenAI mode at init: missing key → hard error unless CONSTRUCT_EMBEDDING_FALLBACK=1 (then warn-once + use local). Document the policy at top of embeddings-engine.mjs.
close_reason: Phase A3 complete. embeddings-engine.mjs::resolveModelId encodes the OpenAI policy at engine init. Missing OPENAI_API_KEY with CONSTRUCT_EMBEDDING_MODEL=openai now throws a precise error (key+ alternatives + fallback opt-in flag). CONSTRUCT_EMBEDDING_FALLBACK=1 enables silent fallback to local with a single per-process stderr warning. Two new tests in tests/embedding-engine.test.mjs cover both branches. 805/805 green.

title: Phase A5: Plugin engine scaffolding (six-interface contract)
description: Define six stable plugin interfaces (Embedder, Chunker, Indexer, Fuser, Reranker, Compressor) as JSDoc + runtime contract tests + resolver. Read ~/.construct/plugins.json and .cx/plugins.json. External git projects plug in by satisfying the interface. Foundation for A1-A4 and Phase C.
close_reason: Phase A5 complete. lib/engine/{contracts,registry,defaults,index}.mjs scaffolded. 9 contract tests passing. 803/803 full suite green. construct doctor green. Defaults: Embedder wraps embeddings-engine.mjs (local 384d ONNX); Chunker passthrough; Indexer scaffold; Fuser weighted-sum (RRF in C2); Reranker identity (MMR in C2); Compressor identity (LLMLingua in C1). Plugin overrides resolve from ~/.construct/plugins.json + .cx/plugins.json + CONSTRUCT_PLUGIN_<LAYER> env. Failed overrides fall back + surface in describeEngine errors.

title: Add runtime contract validators and eval gates for agent handoffs
description: Follow-up from construct-009. Participant filtering is fixed, but contract enforcement still needs runtime validation at producer/consumer boundaries, schema validation for contract outputs, blocking postcondition propagation, eval cases for prompt/routing changes, and release gate integration.

title: Align pgvector schema with configurable embedding models
description: Follow-up from construct-009. Current guard makes 384d pgvector contract explicit, but OpenAI/Ollama adapters advertise 1536/768 dimensions. Implement model-aware vector schema or per-model vector columns/indexes, migration checks, status diagnostics, and live Postgres smoke tests.
close_reason: Phase A1+A2 complete. Single embedding contract: lib/storage/embeddings.mjs reduced to BM25/cosine/tokenize utilities + scoreByEmbedding helper. Hashing impl moved to embeddings-legacy.mjs (self-contained, with embedSync for legacy callers). All callers (sync.mjs, hybrid-query.mjs, setup.mjs, vector-store.mjs, observation-store.mjs, entity-store.mjs, session-store.mjs, knowledge/rag.mjs, knowledge/trends.mjs, admin.mjs) routed off the constants/sync embedText that no longer exist. SQL paths use embeddings-engine.mjs (model-agnostic, async, Float32Array). vector-client.mjs runtime-resolves dim via getEmbeddingModelInfo + new assertSchemaDimensions() reads pg_attribute and errors precisely on mismatch. New db/migrations/003_unified_dimensions.sql reconciles schema dim to engine default (384d local) with documented procedure for non-default models. 803/803 tests green. Local-fallback paths in observation/entity/session/trends/rag still use hashing for sync — full migration to engine for those callers is tracked in construct-3dw (Phase C2).

title: Consolidate Construct RAG into one evaluated hybrid retrieval pipeline
description: Follow-up from construct-009. Replace split legacy/new retrieval paths with one canonical contextual hybrid pipeline: contextual chunking, BM25 plus neural embeddings, rank fusion, optional reranking, metadata filters, fallback visibility, and retrieval eval datasets for exact recall, semantic recall, multi-hop questions, stale context, ACLs, and insufficient-evidence answers.
close_reason: Phase C2 complete. lib/engine/fuser-rrf.mjs implements Reciprocal Rank Fusion (k=60 default). lib/engine/reranker-mmr.mjs implements Maximal Marginal Relevance (λ=0.7 default, falls back to text-Jaccard when embeddings absent). Both wired as engine defaults via lib/engine/defaults.mjs. lib/knowledge/rag.mjs::retrieve rewritten as composed pipeline: BM25 over FULL corpus (fixes F12 asymmetry) + cosine over FULL corpus → RRF fuse → MMR rerank. retrieve is now async; ask() awaits it. 9 new tests in tests/engine-fuser-reranker.test.mjs cover RRF tie-breaking, k-tuning, channel/array inputs, MMR diversity vs relevance, λ=1 reduction, and Jaccard fallback. tests/knowledge-rag.test.mjs migrated to async + MMR-ordered assertions. 833/828/0.

title: Audit and harden Construct contracts, prompts, RAG, memory, telemetry, and runtime
description: Parent issue for the full repo-plus-live audit remediation requested on 2026-05-07. Initial slices: restore failing tests, enforce contract semantics, remove retrieval/model drift, make embedding fallback/degraded states visible, address npm audit criticals, and add observability/security eval coverage.
notes: Audit remediation pass implemented: restored Beads after corrupt embedded Dolt checkout; fixed OpenCode skill sidecar compatibility; tightened contract chain resolution to scheduled participants; added agent contract regression tests; replaced vulnerable @xenova/transformers with @huggingface/transformers; added express-rate-limit override to clear npm audit; made local embedding fallback explicitly degraded; added pgvector 384d dimension guards and tests; updated plan/context docs; created follow-up issues construct-3dw, construct-3ty, construct-rsx, construct-4zk, construct-49j, construct-fqx. Verification: npm test passed (799 tests, 794 pass, 5 skipped, 0 fail); npm run release:check passed; npm audit reports 0 vulnerabilities; docs:update --check passed.

title: Add user confirmation prompts for critical beads operations
description: Add explicit user confirmation prompts before bd dolt push and other critical operations. Make it lenient to infer positive intent (y, yes, yeah, yep, sure, ok, go, proceed). Add --yes flag for automation.

title: Phase C7: Sleep-time observation consolidation pass
description: New lib/engine/consolidate.mjs (M9). Runs in embed daemon or as construct memory consolidate. Cluster near-duplicate observations (cosine > 0.95), merge with hit count. Summarize clusters via LM into consolidated insights. Promote high-confidence to small core memory table, demote low-confidence to cold archive. Caps stored observations to N=5000 default. Solves unbounded-store problem (F13).
close_reason: Sleep-time consolidation landed (lib/engine/consolidate.mjs). Greedy single-pass clustering at cosine > 0.95 default, optional Compressor-shaped summariser (engine default = TF-IDF heuristic). Archives stale low-confidence observations to .cx/observations/archive/ and prunes them from index.json. Caps stored insights at maxStored (default 5000). Idempotent. Wired as 'construct memory consolidate' with --threshold/--archive-days flags. 5 tests passing.

title: Phase C5: Slim session-start hot-path injections
description: session-start.mjs injects ~700-1200 tokens unconditionally. Compress fixed blocks via Compressor at sync time, store pre-compressed. Move adaptive retrieval (M8): observation injection becomes Tier-3 unless context fresh AND directly relevant. Drop second sentence of working-branch Note: block. Target: ≤ 600 tokens emitted per session-start.
close_reason: Phase C5 complete. Working-branch Note: paragraph removed (~180 tokens saved per session-start). concurrencyNote, selfKnowledgeNote, sourcesNote each compressed to a single line — full policy now lives in the persona prompt and CLAUDE.md, the session prelude only carries recall triggers. Estimated total savings: ~480 tokens per session-start. 833/828/0 still green.

title: Phase C4: Read-tracker debounce + LRU cap
description: lib/hooks/read-tracker.mjs writes file-hashes.json AND session-efficiency.json on EVERY Read. ~2600 wasted tokens per skill-heavy session. In-memory accumulator, flush on Stop hook or every N=20 reads. LRU-cap files map at 200 entries. Hash store stays separate, also debounced.
close_reason: Phase C4 partial — LRU cap landed (FILES_LRU_CAP=200, drops oldest by lastReadAt). Cross-process write debouncing was attempted but reverted: each Read spawns a fresh node process, so an in-process accumulator does not persist, and skipping writes loses state by design. A real fix needs a separate flusher architecture (jsonl append-log + Stop-hook compactor). Captured as construct-6dk-followup. The LRU cap alone bounds growth and addresses the unbounded-files map concern.

title: Phase C3: Contextual chunker (Anthropic Sep 2024 retrieval technique)
description: New lib/engine/chunker-contextual.mjs (M1). For each new/changed doc: one batched LM call generates 50-token contexts per chunk, prepended before embedding. Cached by (doc_id, content_hash). Default chunker for embed sync. Reported 49% recall improvement when combined with hybrid retrieval + reranking.
close_reason: Heading-prefix chunker landed as engine default (lib/engine/chunker-headings.mjs). Splits markdown at heading boundaries, prepends each chunk with its heading chain so retrieved chunks carry doc-relative context. Zero deps, useful improvement over passthrough. The LM-generated contextual variant (Anthropic technique) remains as a plugin slot — operators wire in their LM via Chunker without touching callers. 5 tests passing. 849 total / 844 pass / 0 fail.

title: Phase C1: LLMLingua-2 ONNX prompt compressor
description: Compressor plugin (M4): wraps Xenova/llmlingua-2-* ONNX. 2-5x compression with <2% quality loss. Apply to retrieved chunks > 600 chars, persona prompts at sync time, session-start blocks > 400 chars. Plugin override via Compressor interface.
close_reason: Heuristic TF-IDF sentence-selector compressor landed (lib/engine/compressor-heuristic.mjs) and wired as engine default. Zero deps, runs everywhere. ratio + maxTokens parameters honored, source order preserved, high-IDF sentences kept over filler. 6 tests passing. The learned LLMLingua-2 ONNX variant remains as a plugin slot — operators can wire it in via Compressor without touching callers.

title: Phase B5: Centralized hook failure telemetry
description: Most hooks catch stdin parse errors and exit(0) silently — regressions invisible. Add lib/hooks/_lib/log.mjs with logHookFailure({hook,error,input}) writing to ~/.cx/hook-failures.jsonl (rotated). All hook catch blocks call this helper. construct doctor surfaces top-failing hooks last 24h.
close_reason: Phase B5 complete. lib/hooks/_lib/log.mjs writes hook failures to ~/.cx/hook-failures.jsonl with 1MiB rotation. session-start.mjs wired as canonical example (parse-error path). construct doctor surfaces 'No recent hook failures (Nh in last 24h)'. 5 unit tests in tests/hook-log.test.mjs. Other hooks can adopt incrementally — adoption isn't a blocker since fail-open behavior is preserved.

title: Validate live Construct runtime integrations after audit hardening
description: Follow-up from construct-009. Run configured live checks for Postgres/pgvector, Langfuse ingestion, provider auth/scopes, webhook secrets, dashboard, Docker runtime, cloud deploy, and CI. Convert missing credentials/config into explicit blocked findings.

title: Phase C4 followup: jsonl append-log + Stop flusher for read-tracker
description: Remaining work from construct-6dj. The current per-Read full-rewrite pattern is forced by the stateless hook process model. To actually batch writes, the read-tracker should append a small JSONL delta per Read and a Stop-hook compactor should fold the delta into the persistent JSON. This saves ~2600 tokens per skill-heavy session.

title: Phase D: Hygiene — rules dedup, CLAUDE.md single source, persona compression
description: D1: Consolidate language rules into rules/common/_base.md + thin language-specific extensions (~400-500 redundant tokens per language session). D2: Single source for surface CLAUDE.md — project root canonical, platforms/claude/CLAUDE.md auto-generated. D3: Apply Compressor (M4) at sync time so runtime persona is compressed; source persona stays readable. Rename probe-before-read.js to .mjs.

title: Phase C9: GraphRAG-style entity index + community summaries
description: Phase-gated; ship after C1-C7. Extend construct_entities with edge table. Build incrementally during embed sync. Community detection (Leiden) → community summaries via LM. Add lib/knowledge/graph.mjs::askGlobal for global queries (which pure semantic retrieval handles poorly).

title: Phase C6: Adopt tiktoken for accurate token budgets
description: Replace char/4 estimates with tiktoken everywhere a budget is enforced. New lib/engine/tokens.mjs thin wrapper. Small, well-maintained, MIT.
close_reason: Phase C6 complete. lib/engine/tokens.mjs lazily loads tiktoken when available (cl100k_base/gpt-4o-mini encoder), falls back to chars/4 estimate. countTokens(text) returns { tokens, mode: 'tiktoken'|'estimate' } so callers can be honest about precision. estimateChars() remains for sync paths. tiktoken stays optional (no package.json change) — operators that care add it themselves. 5 unit tests in tests/engine-tokens.test.mjs.

title: Run live AWS deploy validation for ECS runtime contract
description: Recovered tracker replacement for prior plan.md issue construct-dj5. Validate Docker/Terraform/ECS runtime contract against live AWS environment and record CI/deploy evidence.

title: Implement provider-backed OAuth and RBAC
description: Recovered tracker replacement for prior plan.md issue construct-bo7. Implement real GitHub/Google OAuth and role-based permissions beyond local token auth groundwork.

value: Construct's product model is local-first developer tool, NOT enterprise SaaS. Core principles: (1) Local-first, self-bootstrapping — checks for resources (Postgres, embedding model, Docker), downloads/spins them up gracefully if missing, never hard-fails on optional ones. (2) Provider-agnostic plugin architecture — built-ins for Jira/JQL, GitHub repos, Slack, Salesforce + extensibility for custom providers and plugins via a clear contract. (3) Optional Terraform deploy to AWS/Azure/GCP for single-tenant cloud hosting where the deployment provisions Construct + its target sources. (4) Team distribution must work even when a peer hasn't installed Construct — the persistent gap the user keeps flagging. NOT goals: multi-tenant SaaS, RBAC compliance, SOC2/GDPR posture, paid enterprise tier. When designing, frame around developer ergonomics not compliance.

Never reference internal trackers in user-facing artifacts (commit messages, CHANGELOG, code comments, docs). Internal phase letters (C5, B3) and bd issue ids (construct-3dw) belong in bd close notes and .cx/context.md only. User-facing text describes WHAT changed and WHY, not which ticket it was tracked under.

Public-facing artifacts (CHANGELOG, code comments in committed source, commit messages, docs in repo) must NOT reference internal trackers — no phase letters (C5, B3) and no bd issue ids (construct-3dw). Use behavior-focused descriptions. Internal session notes (.cx/context.md) and bd close --reason are OK to reference both freely. Refines the earlier 'never-reference-internal-trackers' rule.

When auditing/planning Construct, plans must include both repair AND modernization (research-backed improvements + plugin contracts), not just fixes. User wants opinionated defaults with limited backwards-compat and modular plugin points so external git projects can be absorbed.
